thread:
mikaela: Quick ask — Sales needs a single-page solution brief for enterprise prospects focused on security + SLA + deployment choices. Short, consumable, and field-ready by EOD tomorrow. Can we sync on what must be on it?

samir: +1. Target buyer is platform/security/compliance leads at mid+ enterprise. Keep language crisp: risk reduction, predictable costs, auditability.

alina: Need the hard facts up front: VPC/private control plane, KMS/HSM support, SOC2/GDPR language, on-prem option. Also call out dedicated capacity SLA tiers.

jamie: For SLA bullets — propose: 99.95% uptime (Dedicated), <150ms p95 for common token lengths on dedicated pools, fallback to compatible regions/models on capacity events. Want numbers we can stand behind.

mikaela: Good. DevRel can provide benchmark numbers and a short graph. @devrel_josh can you drop a couple of lines we can quote?

devrel_josh: We ran internal perf on typical chat workload (avg 256 tokens). On a small dedicated fleet we see p50~40ms, p95~120ms with batching tuned. Embedding throughput ~600/sec/GPU for sML models. Happy to provide a mini table.

alina: Include privacy snippet: "Customer data never used to train models; optional data plane isolation; audit logs for every request." Also mention KMS integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure) + HSM note.

jamie: Messaging hook: "Production-grade inference with enterprise controls" then three micro-sections: Security & Compliance, Predictable SLAs & Economics, Deployment Flexibility. Each 2–3 bullets.

mikaela: Love that. For sales enablement add a one-line ROI stat: typical customers see 20–40% reduction in per-token cost vs unmanaged self-hosting due to batching/caching/quantization recommendations. Keep it conservative.

samir: Routing plan for inbound leads: if ARR_estimate >= 500k OR security_requirements == high -> route to AE + Solutions Eng; else self-serve + onboarding docs. Also add checkbox for private deployment interest.

mikaela: Can we include a tiny flow snippet for lead routing?

samir: Use this: ```if prospect.tier == "enterprise" or prospect.requires_private_deploy: route = "AE+SE" else route = "self-serve"``` super short.

alina: Also need legal & compliance boilerplate: contact for DPA, ISO/SOC attestation availability line, and reference to on-prem package.

mikaela: Okay next: format. One pager, 1 column, top banner with headline, 3 micro-sections, a 2-row mini table (latency / throughput) and a tiny checklist for next steps + contact. Jamie, can you mock layout? Samir, can you draft copy? I will assemble and run it by security.

jamie: I can do an initial InDesign/figma layout by lunchtime.

samir: I'll draft the copy now and post in this thread for quick edits. Expect first pass in 45m.

security_bot: Reminder: for any external-facing doc claiming SLAs or certifications, route to security review. Use tag #sec-review and allow 48h for attestation checks.

mikaela: Noted. If we timebox security to 48h, we should still have a field-ready draft for AE use (marked "preliminary") — include disclaimers.

devrel_josh: I'll attach micro-bench table and short command example for routing/rollout in a comment on the doc. Eg: ```rollout: canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%```

mikaela: Perfect. Thanks team. If no blockers, plan: copy & layout by EOD tomorrow, security review early next week, ship to sales enablement repo after sign-off. :thumbsup:

samir: Sounds good. I'll post draft here when ready.
__notes: Follow-up: once assembled mark doc with 'prelim' and tag #sec-review per security_bot.
